full_text:
💙 A NEW ‘SONIC’ MOVIE IS COMING IN 2028!

Paramount Pictures has officially added an untitled ‘SONIC’ universe event film to its release calendar for December 22, 2028! 🦔💨

The movie will be separate from ‘SONIC THE HEDGEHOG 4,’ which arrives in 2027. No story details or characters have been revealed yet! 🔥

🎮 Which character would you love to see get their own movie?
